items.title: GAMER MOBS
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Time to become the ultimate mob gamer! These mobs are ready to game all day!

+ Includes 10 mob themed skins with gaming headsets

items.title: ALIENS
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
ALIENS are invading the planet! Choose any of these epic alien skins and take over the galaxy!

+ Includes 10 alien skins

items.title: Teen Animal Attire
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
From shirts to overalls and even hoodies, you can now express your love for animals in many ways! Regardless of which animal is your favourite, you’ll look cute and fashionable in these modern teen clothes that are super trendy. 

- 12 skins
- Trendy animal clothes
- Includes 1 free skin

items.title: Anime Construction Workers
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Check out these cool anime constriction workers. Hard at work in stylish anime themed skins.

- 10 anime skins

items.title: Futuristic Guardians
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Have you ever imagined how the security of society would be in the future? Well, wait no longer! With the Futuristic Guardians skin pack you can become a robotically enhanced human; fight thieves and above all take care of society to completely free it from evil.

- Ten skins
- One skin free 
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Gentlemen & Ladies 2
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Keep glitter and shine wherever you go with the Gentlemen & Ladies 2 skins! Everyone will have an eye on you and you will be the coolest player out there. Choose your favorite skin right now and start flaunting!

+ 14 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Diversity
items.creator: Zombocron
items.description:
Experience the beloved massive multi-genre map with 10 unique games packed into one epic world! Battle the arena. Complete the trivia. Do parkour. Survive and farm. Solve puzzles. Fall through droppers. The list goes on but the choice is yours!

+ 10 unique games inside 1 huge world
+ 20 secret collectibles to find
+ Updated for Vibrant Visuals

- by Zombocron and qmagnet
items.changelog: Diversity has been updated for Vibrant Visuals!

items.title: Regular Teens
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Some say the teenage years are the best period of our whole life!
Take that into consideration and enjoy them as much as you can.

+ 6 exclusive regular teens you can choose from, in order to live the teenage years right now.
+ Perfect for anyone willing to explore the pure adolescence with their friends.

items.title: Sleepover Teens
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Check out this incredible skin pack! Sleepover Teens to have fun around.

- 12 sleepover teens skins
- 6 male skins
- 6 female skins

items.title: Bunny Crew
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Look who's here! The bunnies are distributing chocolate eggs to everyone! Hmm... Why don't you come and help them too?

- 10 unique skins!
- Very cute and cool!

items.title: Craftable Village
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Why build a village if you can craft one? Discover the greatest adventures in the different villages. Will you keep your village safe? Craft your village, it couldn't be easier, could it?

+ 5 different villages
+ Craftable
+ Survival spawn

Created by Block Studios and Mine-North

items.title: Ocean Life
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Dive into a vast aquatic life full of whales, sharks, seahorses and much more fish. Fight dangerous sharks or swim in large custom aquariums with your favourite mantas and jellyfishes.

+ 13 new underwater Animals
+ 2 Vehicle
+ Multiplayer friendly
+ Big custom island
+ 7 Custom Items

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Heartbeat
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
These skins are meant for love, courage, and strength! Whether it’s a bear, ninja, techno robot, or enderman they all have powerful and cute hearts to show! Wear your hearted skin with pride!

-8 heartfelt skins!
-Hourglass Father Time skin! 
-By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Freedom Aesthetic
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description: Our gift is the opportunity to choose!

items.title: Sus Invaders
items.creator: Duh
items.description: These futuristic invaders have something to hide!

items.title: Glass Boxy
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: In this skin pack you'll find boba tea, jelly beans, honey and so much more! Walk around as a jar full of cash. Or maybe become a delicious and pretty cake in a jar dessert! These HD glass jar skins look super cool and are fun to use!

items.title: Demon Wedding
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: This wedding is quite the spooky spectacle! They are indeed horrifically beautiful creatures that deserve love too! Come join these demons on this night to remember! You might want to leave early if you know what I mean. Or maybe roleplay as a guest or the lovely bride to be! Make this night of horror all about you!

items.title: Evil Things
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: In this world we live in there are evil things. They scare many and intrigue others. These skins are dark and creepy with an evil glare. Roleplay as an evil creature from the places nightmares are made of! Which scary horror skin will you choose?

items.title: Dogs
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Dog lovers will love this cute pup pack! Become an adorable lovable doggo with one of these skins! You got paws and a wagging tail now so go and chase cats to your hearts content!

- 13 dog skins

items.title: Masks and Shadows
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These shadows wear masks to hide their true nature! Some shadows are sus while others are friendly. It's scary when you don't know which one is evil and which is good!

- 12 shadow skins

items.title: Neon Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Be a neon teen! Roleplay in glowing fashion!

+ 10 skins included!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Skyblock One Chunk
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: Skyblock One Chunk is the next big skyblock challenge you should try! Survive your life on a single chunk! Fear not going far for resources, everything you need is right there! Can you survive?

items.title: Fashion Icons
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
After a trip to the city, you've returned with the latest and greatest in fashion to show off to your friends! Choose from many cool styles until you find the one that's just "you", Will you be the talk of the block with your stylish fits? 

+ 11 skins
+ 1 free skin
+ By Ready, Set, Block! & PartyZone

items.title: Anime Fantasy
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Set out as a valiant knight on his way to victory or be a queen ruling over an entire realm with these fantasy-inspired characters! Whether you're riding solo or roleplaying with your friends, we've got you covered with every character that you need to fit your role.

+ 11 skins
+ 1 free skin
+ By Ready, Set, Block!
